author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Four routers (12x8 boxes with two 4-unit antennas, after the Lucide router body) in a 2x2 mesh with a dot link between the routers of each row; reads as four separate routers, no longer as a ladder of joined boxes.
omissions: The reference's vertical and diagonal link dashes are left out: at 8-unit clearance the 32-unit height holds only the two router rows; the horizontal dashes shrink to dots.
